style: Painterly storybook illustration in the style of the existing Himawari scenes: warm textured gouache and watercolour, soft grainy paper, hand-drawn ink lines, a small Mediterranean hill town. Landscape 4:3, 1024x768. No text, letters or signage anywhere in the image.

characters.Harry: Harry, the narrator: an adult man of about thirty, messy dark-brown hair, light stubble, olive-green shirt with rolled sleeves, charcoal trousers, brown boots, a worn brown satchel. Always clearly an adult man.
characters.Valentine: Valentine Summers, eight years old, who looks like a genuinely sweet, kind, ordinary little girl: dark-brown bob with a fringe, rosy cheeks, a warm open smile, a red dress with a white collar, white socks, scuffed Mary Janes. Only three quiet clues, never emphasised: a small hair clip shaped like an eclipsed sun (a black disc with a thin golden ring) holding back her fringe; unusually bright, attentive amber eyes that are always looking at the one thing that matters; and a child's sticker-covered notebook from which, if you look closely, a page of precise technical schematics (orbits, gears, sunflower diagrams) peeks out.
characters.Valentine (unmasked): Valentine revealed as the Destroyer of Suns: the same eight-year-old with the same bob, red dress and eclipse hair clip, now in an oversized white lab coat with rolled-up sleeves and brass goggles pushed up on her forehead, utterly calm, the sweetness gone from her smile, lit by the cold blue glow of a hand-built brass machine stamped with the same eclipse emblem. Small but frightening: the most composed person in the room.
characters.Miss Summers: Miss Summers, the new teacher and Valentine's mother: about forty, dark hair in a tight bun, thin glasses, grey-blue blouse, navy skirt, a stack of folders, serenely unbothered.
characters.Neighbour / Miss Montreau: Harry's neighbour, the fire woman Miss Montreau: about thirty-five, athletic, brown hair in a ponytail, orange firefighter trousers with braces over a dark T-shirt.
characters.Street sweeper: The street sweeper (member of the secret Order of the Sunflower): middle-aged, black moustache, blue-grey coveralls and cap, twig broom and bin cart; a small sunflower pin.
characters.Hobo: The hobo: wild grey hair and beard, knitted beanie, tattered brown coat, red scarf, sits on the pavement beside the pizzeria with cardboard covered in his pictograms.
characters.Fermat: Fermat, the pizzeria owner: stocky, fifties, thick black moustache, red bandana, white T-shirt, flour-dusted apron.
characters.Guard: The water-plant security guard (Valentine's father): past fifty, overweight, grey hair, navy uniform with peaked cap and tie, tired kind eyes.
characters.Gardener: The park gardener: elderly, white beard, straw hat, olive apron.
characters.The Voice: The Voice is never shown. Only a rusty sewer door / grate low in the wall of a narrow, dark, litter-strewn alley, perhaps two faint glints in the dark behind the bars.
